hero.badge: Healthcare : A Lifeline for a better tomorrow
hero.desc: Transforms hospital discharge summaries into a plain-language daily medicine schedule for the family caregiver. AI reads, clinical rules decide, missing means flagged.

hero.trustStrip: 24/7 Response · Licensed Medical Team · Confidential Care · ABHA / FHIR-Aligned
